mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_chat_session (session_id, user_id, title, pinned, message_count, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{pinned}, #{messageCount}, #{lastActiveAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT session_id, title, message_count, pinned, last_active_at, created_at FROM ai_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pinned DESC, last_active_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_session SET last_active_at = #{lastActiveAt}, message_count = message_count + 1, updated_at = #{lastActiveAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_chat_session SET message_count = message_count + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
